title: Petition of Cape Cod Shuttle Bus Service Industry, Inc., requesting the Department of Public Utilities to issue it a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 7, as amended, to operate motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over a certain route in the Town of Yarmouth, Massachusetts, to be restricted to guests of certain motels for transportation to and from Seagull Beach.
petitioner: Cape Cod Shuttle Bus Service Industry, Inc.
